messages:
alex: Heads-up — three GPUs in us-west-2-gpu-pool-3 started showing intermittent Xid 31 / ECC growth this morning. Observed on nodes gpu-uw2-23, gpu-uw2-47, gpu-uw2-58.

marta: Ugh. Any host-level symptoms? High error rates or just logs?

alex: Primarily kernel logs + nvidia-smi ECC counter increase. No OOMs yet but one slot hit 50% throttling on long seq workloads. quick snippets: 
```
# dmesg | grep -i xid
NVRM: Xid (31): Ch 00000001, Xid 31, PID 4021, GPU 00000000
# nvidia-smi -q -d ECC | grep -E "Single Bit|Double Bit"
Single Bit ECC Errors : 12
Double Bit ECC Errors : 0
```

sam: Sounds flaky. Are these cards on warranty / assigned serials we can RMA?

chloe: I pulled inventory: serials are S/N: SC-3A1-224, SC-3A1-309, SC-3A1-411. Vendor is SuperCompute (enterprise account). They support depot swap and cross-ship.

ops-bot: auto-detect: node gpu-uw2-47 marked for drain by healthcheck rule gpu_ecc_threshold. Task draining started 1749123420.

marta: Good — keep them drained. We should open RMA now before more errors. Can someone create the ticket and request cross-ship? We want replacement in 48 hours if possible.

alex: On it. Opening ticket with vendor — attaching serials and last 7 days of ECC deltas. Will request cross-ship and to waive return label until swapped.

vendor-bot: Vendor ticket created: SC-RMA-2025-8142. Status: awaiting vendor approval. ETA for cross-ship quote: 2 hours. Contact: rma@supercompute.example.com.

sam: FYI we need depot address: Redwood us-west depot (main rack swap) — 420 Infra Way, Portland, OR. Confirmed with ops that depot swap address is allowed under our enterprise SLA.

chloe: Also flagging replacement policy: mark cards as RETIRED in inventory once replacement ship is received and serial returned or depot swap confirmed. I'll prepare inventory update script.

marta: Do we have a plan for scheduling node rebuilds? If replacements arrive same-day we can schedule rolling replacements with maintenance window tonight 02:00-04:00 PT. Otherwise next-night window.

alex: Suggest order: 1) vendor cross-ship to depot, 2) on-site tech performs depot swap (swap new card into server), 3) on-site tech returns defective card to vendor in same shipment. That minimizes downtime.

sam: Agreed. Also adding a verification step: after swap, run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=ecc.errors.volatile.single_bit.errors --format=csv` and run a small 30-min smoke workload to ensure no Xid regressions.

chloe: I've made a tiny playbook: 
1) Drain node, suspend scheduling
2) Snapshot running containers + migrate if needed
3) Perform depot swap
4) Run verification commands and smoke tests
5) If pass, mark inventory replaced + close ticket

marta: Put the playbook in runbook repo and tag on-call. Also, do we need to escalate for capacity? These are 3 cards but same pool; we might see slowdowns.

alex: Capacity-wise we have 8 spare GPUs in us-west spare-pool. I'll pre-warm two into the pool so autoscaler doesn't place heavy jobs on remaining cards.

vendor-bot: Update: SC-RMA-2025-8142 approved. Cross-ship arranged to Portland depot. Tracking: XPSHIP-991122. Expected arrival at depot: 1749200000 (unix).

sam: Great. Chloe — please coordinate on-site tech availability for swap around arrival window. Ops-bot, please keep the nodes drained and report any scheduling attempts.

ops-bot: Affirmative. Nodes gpu-uw2-23/gpu-uw2-47/gpu-uw2-58 remain cordoned until manual uncordon. Will post when swap complete.

marta: One more ask — log the per-card ECC baseline before replacement into the ticket notes. Helps vendor triage and potential batch RMA.

alex: Done, added deltas and 30-day graphs to SC-RMA-2025-8142.

chloe: I'll update inventory when vendor provides final serial of replacement. Also adding tag "rma-2025-8142" to nodes so we can search later.

vendor-bot: Shipment scanned at origin. Carrier ETA to depot: 48h. Tracking link: https://ship.example.com/XPSHIP-991122

marta: Thanks team. Keep updates concise in this thread only. If any node shows new Double Bit ECC or repeated Xid 31 after swap, escalate to me + infra-leads. :thumbsup:

alex: Will follow up with post-swap verification note and close once ticket done.

sam: Looping in support if customers see perf regressions during rebuild: @support-team.

chloe: Noted. I'll also schedule inventory delta job after closure.

ops-bot: Task reminder: re-enable scheduling only after manual signoff.
